_comment: Vertical trade-identity copy — see templates/restoration/vertical-tokens.json for the contract. Consumed by build_site.py resolve_tokens() via verticals.resolve_template(slug, 'vertical-tokens.json'). {display_name}/{city}/{state} are formatted at scaffold time. Per-client overrides: plan-input.json brand.{trade_noun,specialist_phrase,announcement_suffix,tagline,cta_label,home_about_blurb}. NO 24/7 default in this vertical: environmental testing is appointment-shaped work, so the defaults sell independence and lab-verified accuracy instead of emergency dispatch (a client who genuinely runs an emergency line overrides per-client). INDEPENDENCE RULE: never phrase this vertical as restoration or remediation — the client tests, verifies, and reports; they do not do the cleanup.
tagline: Independent environmental testing and inspections in {city}, {state}.
home_about_blurb: {display_name} provides independent environmental testing and inspections for homes and businesses across {city} and the surrounding {state} area. From mold and air quality testing to asbestos, lead, and water testing, every assessment is backed by accredited laboratory analysis and a clear written report. Because we don't perform the remediation ourselves, our findings are unbiased: we have no incentive to find problems that aren't there.
